papers.title: Priming Base Models for Agentic Post-Training: An Open Midtraining Recipe
papers.summary: Presents an open midtraining stage between pretraining and post-training that prepares base models for agentic software-engineering tasks, using 256K-context training on repositories, pull requests, commit histories, build logs and a small share of agentic traces. After identical SFT it improves two Nemotron models on SWE-bench Verified, Multilingual and Pro, and proposes short fixed-SFT runs as a more reliable evaluation than base-model proxy metrics.

papers.title: Stochastic Gradient Descent: A Nonlinear Time Series Perspective
papers.summary: Treats constant-step-size SGD as an iterated random function and proves geometric moment contraction, yielding central limit theorems, invariance principles and alpha-stable limits for averaged SGD. It also analyzes step-size sensitivity, proposes an improved Richardson-Romberg extrapolation for bias reduction, and introduces online inference methods with confidence intervals approaching nominal coverage (accepted to JRSSB).
